subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Recognizing Scam Red Flags
description: A quick win: understand Recognizing Scam Red Flags.

hook.text: Every scam shares the same warning signs. Learn five, and you'll spot most of them.

buildup.text: Urgency, secrecy, unusual payment methods, unsolicited contact, and too-good-to-be-true offers.

discovery.text: If a message hits two or more of those flags, the probability of fraud is extremely high.

twist.text: Scammers know these red flags too — and they work hard to disguise them.

climax.text: The best defense is a mental checklist that you apply to every unexpected request for money or data.

punchline.text: Five red flags. Five seconds. Most scams caught.

quiz.question: Which is NOT a common scam red flag?
options: Urgency and pressure to act now
A request sent through official mail
Demand for payment via gift cards
